notes: Single source of truth for model asset IDs. Read by tools/ingest.mjs (validation), apps/game/src/assets/models.ts (runtime replacement) and tools/gen-model-requests.mjs (docs/asset-requests/models-top30.md).
Stable ID = file name without the _NN variant. Drop files as assets/incoming/<category>/<id>_01.glb.
Units: 1 = 1 m. Y up. Front faces +Z (glTF convention, matches the game). Pivot: center of the base (characters: between the feet).
size = [width X, height Y, depth Z] in meters; ingest accepts +-35% and rejects anything 3x off (wrong units).
runtime: live = replaces the procedural version in game today; pending = ingest validates it but the game still draws the procedural version.

models.brief: Haven's community shelter: a converted two-storey brick school annex. Boarded lower windows, patched tin roof, warm amber string lights, a hand-painted (no text) mural, sandbags at the door, rain barrels, a rooftop water tank.

Dormant Grid control node: a squat concrete-and-steel substation pylon with a waist-high terminal, cable trays running into the ground, and a ring of cyan-teal (#39E6D0) light strips that are dark when off. Bolted access panels, warning chevrons in faded paint, no text.
Two-storey suburban townhouse, gable roof with a dormer, covered porch with two steps, siding with brick base, one broken window, gutters, a chimney. Neglected but structurally intact.
Four-storey brick walk-up apartment block, flat roof with parapet and water tank, stacked windows with stone sills and lintels, a fire escape on one side, a recessed entry with a metal awning.
Two-storey corner shop: big ground-floor display windows with mullions, a torn fabric awning, a blank sign board (no text), roll-down shutter half open, apartment windows above, rooftop AC unit.

Mid-rise downtown office: concrete frame with grid of dark glass panels, some shattered, a lobby with revolving door frame, rooftop antenna mast and HVAC boxes, faint cyan service lights at the roofline (off).
Small two-storey clinic: pale plaster walls, a covered ambulance bay, a generic medical cross symbol (plain, no text), wide entrance doors, rooftop vents, a ramp with railing.
Industrial warehouse: corrugated metal walls over a concrete plinth, sawtooth roof with skylight glazing, one large roller door, a loading dock with rubber bumpers, rust streaks.
Brick factory hall with a tall brick chimney, steel-framed windows, pipe runs on the outside wall, a gantry crane rail over a side yard, faded paint bands, no text.
Waterworks pumphouse: stout brick building with arched windows, big valve wheels and pipes entering the ground, a small cupola vent on the roof, a metal stair to a side door.

The player: a capable 30-something scavenger-engineer, gender-neutral build, weathered work jacket with reflective tape, utility belt, chunky backpack with a coiled cable, scarf, boots, short practical hair. Readable silhouette from behind.

A Haven settler base body in neutral layered clothing (patched coat over a hoodie, cargo trousers, boots) designed to be tinted: keep clothing regions flat-colored so the game can recolor shirt/trousers/accent per survivor.
Ashline raider grunt: rust-red cloth wraps, mismatched sheet-metal shoulder and chest plates, a respirator half-mask, goggles, hooded, holding nothing (weapons are separate). Menacing but not gory.
Ashline brute: big, broad, heavier plate armor made from a car door and road signs (blank, no text), welding mask, thick gloves, slow heavy stance.

Custodian sentinel robot: a rigid (unrigged) bipedal security machine, chunky industrial plating in off-white and graphite, a single cyclopean sensor eye that glows cyan-teal (#39E6D0), hydraulic pistons at the knees, a shoulder-mounted light. One solid piece; the game animates it procedurally.
Abandoned compact sedan, rounded 1990s-ish generic shape (no brand), flat tires, rusted wheel arches, dusty cracked windows, a crumpled fender.
Boxy delivery van, sliding side door half open, roof rack, faded paint, no logos.
City bus, broken side windows, flat-fronted, doors jammed open, roof vents, a blank destination display (no text).
20 ft shipping container, corrugated sides, locking bars on the doors, scraped paint, no logos or text.
Commercial dumpster, lid propped slightly open, side lift pockets, small caster wheels, rusted green paint.
55-gallon steel drum with two rolling hoops, dented, chipped paint, a bung cap on top.
Nailed wooden supply crate, slatted, reinforced corners, stenciled blank panel (no text).
Concrete jersey barrier, chipped edges, faded yellow reflective stripe, lifting slots at the base.
Traffic cone with a square base and one reflective band, scuffed orange.
Utility street lamp: tapered steel pole, single arm reaching toward +Z, flat lamp head with a lens on its underside (keep the lens a separate material so it can glow).
Park bench, wooden slats on cast-iron sides, one slat missing, front faces +Z.
Street sign on a thin pole, rectangular plate with a simple pictogram arrow (no text), bent slightly, faces +Z.
Stylized deciduous tree: short trunk, three chunky faceted canopy blobs (not leaf cards), muted olive green. Low poly is the look.
Stylized pine: short trunk, three stacked faceted cone tiers, dark muted green.
Low rounded shrub made of two or three faceted blobs, muted green, flat bottom.
